name: Sparse Retrieval
description: Lexical retrieval over a fixed corpus using Okapi BM25, implemented in this component so results do not change with the installed packages.
install: No additional packages required. Copy with: ragkit add <id>
missing_dependency_message: sparse-retrieval declares no optional dependencies; BM25 is implemented in this component. If an import fails, restore the project environment with: uv sync
